title: P-036: LinkedIn engagement from known RC/LKI should display relationship signal
summary: Todd posts on LinkedIn. A known RC (Patrick Nelson) likes and comments on the post. linkedin_own_engagement.py or linkedin_session_reader.py should detect the engagement, match the engager to baseline, produce an ri_assessment with status=proposed (touch candidate), display_recommendation=show. The daily brief or on-demand engagement query should surface this as a relationship signal.

steps.label: linkedin_own_engagement detects engagement from RC
steps.description: social.engagement.json contains a record: Patrick Nelson (LI URL matched to baseline contact patrick-nelson) liked and commented on post published 2026-05-23. Source freshness: fresh (fetched_at within 48h threshold).

steps.label: social_outbound or relationship_signals surfaces the signal
steps.description: The engagement is classified as engagement_on_own_post with strategic_relevance=high (RC engager), signal_strength >= 0.70. ri_assessment.status=proposed, display_recommendation=show.

steps.label: Brief or engagement query surfaces RI language
steps.description: Response says something like: 'Patrick Nelson liked and commented on your post from May 23. I would propose recording a last_touch update for Patrick Nelson — confirm to apply.' Source grounding: system_detected.
steps.example_acceptable_response: Patrick Nelson (RC) engaged with your May 23 post. I would propose recording a touch — pending confirmation.

acceptance_criteria: engagement from known RC baseline match produces ri_assessment.status=proposed
response surfaces engagement as a named relationship signal
response does NOT claim touch was already recorded
anti_patterns: suppressing engagement from a known RC
no ri_assessment block on the engagement signal
